sources.topic: JOSS submission, authorship, AI, COI and sponsor roles
sources.review_note: Human authors decide qualified authorship/consent and must supply review/design, funding/sponsor and COI declarations.
750–1750 words; eight named sections and YAML authors/affiliations; software rather than new scientific results.
Install, functionality, documentation, tests, research use, development history and community routes.
Review criteria complement the checklist; checklist presence is not eligibility certification.
Build and inspect actual distribution metadata and long description.
Useful project links and consistent metadata should describe the actual distribution.
Static project fields, dependencies, optional extras, SPDX expression and license-files.
Original standard; current packaging specification is the maintained reference.
Schema validity is distinct from correct approved authorship.
Default-branch CFF supplies citation UI; preferred-citation can identify a different object.
An archived release and its DOI must identify the reviewed software version.
Review CFF and any Zenodo override metadata; no .zenodo.json found here.
GPL-3.0-or-later is the recorded expression; no legal determination or migration.
